items.title: GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，单任务成本大幅下降
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With Sharply Lower Cost per Task
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with community discussion highlighting large cost and latency reductions alongside mixed reactions to document/slideshow quality and competitive benchmark comparisons.

items.title: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
items.title_zh: Java4Shell：OpenJDK 的 Base64 解码器存在远程代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: Java4Shell: Remote Code Execution in OpenJDK's Base64 Decoder
items.summary: A detailed write-up of a remote code execution vulnerability in OpenJDK triggered during Base64 processing, featuring novel network-based heap grooming techniques and drawing wide technical discussion on detection and impact.

items.title: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine
items.title_zh: Quad9因DNS封锁退出法国，Cloudflare警告先例风险
items.title_en: Quad9 Exits France Over DNS Blocking as Cloudflare Warns of Precedent
items.summary: Cloudflare analyzes Quad9's withdrawal from France following DNS-blocking legal pressure, framing it as an early warning for public resolvers and internet freedom, with community discussion adding insider perspective and scrutiny of Cloudflare's own stance.

items.title: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B
items.title_zh: 英伟达新加坡子公司营收达1040亿美元后，停止披露当地销售数据
items.title_en: Nvidia Halts Singapore Sales Disclosure After $104B Booked Through Local Unit
items.summary: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as its Singaporean subsidiary's external revenue reached $104B, amid US investigations into whether that channel was used to smuggle GPUs to China.

items.title: Solid 2.0
items.title_zh: SolidJS 2.0 发布，带来服务端 RPC 与 live/broadcast 原语
items.title_en: SolidJS 2.0 Ships With Server RPC and Live/Broadcast Primitives
items.summary: SolidJS 2.0 has been released, introducing major framework changes including server RPC and live/broadcast primitives, with discussion focused on developer experience and comparisons to other frontend frameworks.

items.title: Running the full server-side Datasette Python app in the browser with service workers and Pyodide
items.title_zh: Datasette Lite 借助 Service Worker 与 Pyodide 重写，可在浏览器中运行完整 Datasette 应用
items.title_en: Datasette Lite rewritten with service workers and Pyodide to run full Datasette in the browser
items.summary: Simon Willison rewrote Datasette Lite using service workers and Pyodide so the full Datasette Python app runs in the browser with plugin and version support.

items.title_zh: 我国首次实现地月双向高速激光通信，下行速率达 100 Mbps
items.title_en: China Achieves First Bidirectional High-Speed Earth-Moon Laser Communication Link
items.summary: China achieved its first bidirectional high-speed Earth-Moon laser communication link using the DRO-A satellite, reaching 1.25 Mbps uplink and 100 Mbps downlink over more than 400,000 km.
